details: Approved Ultra Premium flagship implemented on the actual web UI, with one CSS theme, dark luxury backdrop, gold/chrome framed cards, distinct accessible fixed local project artwork, neon magenta/cyan/emerald accents, new system/quick tool styling and slim 5-tab navigation. Does not alter routes, stored projects, cloud data, recipes, TTK, Android APK or authentication; web-only refresh. Readability correction from real Xiaomi screenshots: illustrated 3D cards now use an inset dark glass text area, more space for Cyrillic project names, the arrow button is anchored on the right, bottom scroll clearance is increased, wide-project layout avoids double text offset. One active theme, functionality and data unchanged.
